points.title: if 与 unless 引导的条件从句
points.explain: if 表示「如果」，unless 表示「除非」。谈论将来可能发生的事，主句可用 will，从句通常用一般现在时。主句也可以用祈使句提出建议。

examples.en: If you enjoy folk arts, join our puppet group.
examples.zh: 如果你喜欢民间艺术，就加入我们的木偶表演小组吧。

questions.q: If she ______ free tomorrow, she will join the performance.
questions.e: 谈论将来的条件时，if 从句通常用一般现在时。

questions.q: We won't give up ______ we have no other choice.
questions.e: unless 表示「除非」。句意是除非别无选择，否则我们不会放弃。

questions.a: If you need help, ask me.
questions.e: if 条件从句放在句首，之后用逗号和祈使句连接。

points.title: 用 because 和 since 说明原因
points.explain: because 说明直接原因，可回答 Why 提问。since 也可以说明双方已知或容易理解的原因。because 从句和主句之间无需再加 so。

examples.en: The audience cheered because the performance was amazing.
examples.zh: 观众欢呼起来，因为表演很精彩。

questions.q: Why did you join the programme? — ______ I wanted to learn about folk arts.
questions.e: 回答 Why 的直接原因用 Because。

questions.q: ______ we all know the rules, let's start the performance.
questions.e: 引导原因从句。Since 尤其适合说明双方都知道的情况。

questions.q: Choose the correct sentence.
o: Because she practised, so she improved.
She improved because did she practise.
questions.e: because 已经连接原因和结果，无需再用 so。

points.title: 用 when、while 和 as soon as 说明时间
points.explain: when 可以引出时间点或时间段。while 强调某个持续动作正在进行。as soon as 表示「一……就……」。谈论将来的动作时，时间从句通常用一般现在时。

examples.en: I'll make a budget as soon as I get home.

questions.q: I'll call you as soon as I ______ home.
questions.e: as soon as 引导将来时间从句时用一般现在时。

questions.q: I made a shopping list ______ my sister was checking the prices.
questions.e: while 最能强调在核对价格的过程中，另一个动作同时发生。

questions.q: We stayed in the shop ______ the rain stopped.
questions.e: until 表示「直到」。

points.title: 用 where 和 wherever 说明地点
points.explain: where 引出某个地点，wherever 强调「无论在哪里」。地点从句说明主句中的动作发生在什么地方。

examples.en: Put your moneybox where you can find it easily.
examples.zh: 把存钱罐放在你容易找到的地方。

questions.q: Put the moneybox ______ you can see it every day.
questions.e: 从句表示存钱罐应该放在哪里，用 where。

questions.q: ______ you go, keep track of what you spend.
questions.e: wherever 表示「无论你去哪里」。

questions.a: Shop where the prices are lower.
questions.e: where 从句说明购物的地点。

points.title: 用 so that 表示目的
points.explain: so that 表示「以便」时，引出的从句说明做某事的目的。从句中常出现 can、could 或其他情态动词。

examples.en: The guide spoke slowly so that everyone could follow her.
examples.zh: 导游讲得很慢，好让大家都能听懂。

questions.q: We took notes ______ we could remember the story.
questions.e: 记笔记的目的是记住故事，用 so that。

questions.q: They added pictures ______ visitors could understand the history more easily.
questions.e: so that 连接动作和目的。

questions.a: I brought a map so that we could find the museum.
questions.e: 先说明带地图，再用 so that 引出目的。

points.title: 区分 so … that 与 such … that
points.explain: so 后通常接形容词或副词，such 后接名词短语。两种结构都用 that 从句交代实际结果。

examples.en: The statue was so heavy that we couldn't move it.
examples.zh: 雕像太重了，我们搬不动它。

questions.q: The collection was ______ valuable that the museum kept it safe.
questions.e: valuable 是形容词，用 so valuable that。

questions.q: It was ______ a noisy room that I couldn't hear the guide.
questions.e: a noisy room 是名词短语，用 such。

questions.q: It was ______ an interesting exhibition ______ I visited it twice.
questions.e: an interesting exhibition 是名词短语，结果用 that 从句。

points.title: who 在定语从句中作主语
points.explain: 先行词指人时，可以用 who 引出定语从句。who 在从句中作主语时，后面直接接谓语，不能省略或再加一个主语代词。

examples.en: I admire people who help others in difficult times.
examples.zh: 我敬佩在困难时刻帮助别人的人。

questions.q: The woman ______ helped us is a pilot.
questions.e: 先行词 the woman 指人，who 在从句中作主语。

questions.q: Choose the correct sentence.
o: The person who she helped me is a pilot.
The person who helped me is a pilot.
The person helped me is a pilot.
The person where helped me is a pilot.
questions.e: who 已经是从句的主语，无需再加 she。

questions.a: I admire people who help others.
questions.e: who help others 修饰 people。

points.title: who 在定语从句中作宾语
points.explain: 如果从句已经有主语，指人的 who 可以充当从句的宾语。在限定性定语从句中，这种宾语关系词通常可以省略。

examples.en: The pilot who we interviewed told us about her work.
examples.zh: 我们采访的飞行员向我们讲述了她的工作。

questions.q: In 'The pilot who we interviewed was very kind', who is the object of ______.
questions.e: we 是从句主语，who 指接受采访的飞行员，是 interviewed 的宾语。

questions.q: Which sentence can omit who?
o: The boy who won the race is my brother.
The girl who helped me is here.
The teacher who teaches English is kind.
The hero who we interviewed is here.
questions.e: 最后一句从句中已有 we，who 作 interviewed 的宾语，可以省略。

questions.q: 用 who 填空。The person ______ we met is a local hero.
questions.e: the person 指人，who 在 we met 中作宾语。

points.title: 用 that 和 which 描述事物
points.explain: 限定性定语从句的先行词指物时，一般可以用 that 或 which。两者都可以在从句中作主语或宾语。that 也可以指人。

examples.en: The camera which records wildlife runs on solar power.
examples.zh: 这台记录野生动物的相机靠太阳能运行。

questions.q: This is a camera ______ records wildlife at night.
questions.e: 先行词 a camera 指物，which 在从句中作主语。

questions.q: The microphone ______ we bought works well.
questions.e: 先行词指物，关系词是 bought 的宾语，that 和 which 都可用。

questions.a: This is a device which records sound.
questions.e: which records sound 修饰 a device。

points.title: 判断关系词能否省略
points.explain: 限定性定语从句中，关系词作宾语时通常可以省略。关系词作主语时要保留。先找从句里是否已有主语，再判断关系词的作用。

examples.en: The film we watched was about protecting rainforests.
examples.zh: 我们看的电影讲的是如何保护雨林。

questions.q: Which sentence can omit that?
o: The camera that records birds is new.
The device that uses solar power is here.
The report that you wrote is useful.
The forest that lies nearby is protected.
questions.e: you 是从句主语，that 是 wrote 的宾语。

questions.q: Which sentence is correct?
o: The camera records birds is new.
The camera that records birds is new.
The camera where records birds is new.
The camera it records birds is new.
questions.e: 关系词在从句中作主语，不能省略或用 it 替代。

questions.q: 补上一个关系词。The device ______ the school bought works well.
questions.e: 指物的关系词在从句中作宾语，可用 that 或 which。

points.title: 合成词与词类转化
points.explain: 合成是把两个或更多词组成一个新词，如 tooth + brush → toothbrush。转化是拼写形式不变而词性改变，要根据句中位置和意思判断。

examples.en: The report highlights the problem of plastic waste.
examples.zh: 这份报告强调了塑料垃圾的问题。

questions.q: Which word is formed by putting two words together?
questions.e: toothbrush 由 tooth 和 brush 合成。

questions.q: 用 tooth 和 brush 合成一个词。
questions.e: tooth + brush 构成表示「牙刷」的名词。

questions.q: In 'We should shape the material', shape is a ______.
questions.e: 情态动词 should 后接动词原形，shape 在这里表示「使成形」。

points.title: 用前缀和后缀推断词义
points.explain: 派生是在词根或词基上加前缀或后缀。re- 常表示「再次」，-al 可构成形容词，-ly 常把形容词变成副词。判断时还要结合上下文。

examples.en: We can reuse these bottles and use materials more wisely.
examples.zh: 我们可以重复使用这些瓶子，更明智地利用材料。

questions.q: What does re- mean in reuse?
questions.e: re- 表示「再次」，reuse 表示「再使用」。

questions.q: Use the material ______ (wise).
questions.e: 修饰动词 use 用副词 wisely。

questions.q: We discussed the ______ (environment) problems caused by plastic.
questions.e: 修饰名词 problems 要用形容词 environmental。
